say:2:1821402001:1.text: B-B-B-Brenner, I'm serious... Something's not right on the <style="highlight">western beach</style>.

say:3:1821402002:1.text: I know. There are plenty of wrecks out there, and people say the place is haunted.
say:3:1821402002:1.source_cn: 我知道，那边搁浅着不少船，时不时就闹鬼。

say:4:1821402003:1.text: It's always been that way. Don't sweat it, man.
say:4:1821402003:1.source_cn: 这事又不止一年两年了，别这么紧张，老兄。

say:5:1821402004:1.text: B-b-but lately... there have been more and more strange voices.
say:5:1821402004:1.source_cn: 但是最最最最最近……奇怪的声音越来越多。

say:6:1821402005:1.text: Still not our problem. We're here to guard the flower fields and keep trespassers out.
say:6:1821402005:1.source_cn: 那也不管咱们的事。咱们只需要守好花海，别让人悄悄溜进去...

say:7:1821402006:1.text: Besides, you've seen Her Ladyship in a temper. A ghost can't possibly be worse than that.
say:7:1821402006:1.source_cn: 鬼再可怕又怎么样？难道还能比发怒的领主阁下更可怕吗？

say:10:1821402008:1.text: Oh, you're the Graveborn from the Repair House. If you really want to investigate, go right ahead.
say:10:1821402008:1.source_cn: 是修缮屋的亡灵啊。竟然你感兴趣，那就去海滩上看看呗。
say:10:1821402008:1.male: Oh, you're the Graveborn from the Repair House. If you really want to investigate, go right ahead.
say:10:1821402008:1.female: Oh, you're the Graveborn from the Repair House. If you really want to investigate, go right ahead.

say:11:1821402009:1.text: There's a <style="highlight">large shipwreck</style> over there. We've always suspected the strange noises are coming from inside, but we've never gone in to check. We're just too busy... and too exhausted.
say:11:1821402009:1.source_cn: 那里有一艘<style=highlight>搁浅的大船...
say:11:1821402009:1.male: There's a <style="highlight">large shipwreck</style> over there. We've always suspected the strange noises are coming from inside, but we've never gone in to check. We're just too busy... and too exhausted.
say:11:1821402009:1.female: There's a <style="highlight">large shipwreck</style> over there. We've always suspected the strange noises are coming from inside, but we've never gone in to check. We're just too busy... and too exhausted.

say:12:1821402010:1.text: Getting there is a bit tricky. You'll have to pass through a cave deep in the flower fields. Hope you can find it.
say:12:1821402010:1.source_cn: 去那边的路有点绕，需要先经过一个位于花海深处的洞穴。但...
say:12:1821402010:1.male: Getting there is a bit tricky. You'll have to pass through a cave deep in the flower fields. Hope you can find it.
say:12:1821402010:1.female: Getting there is a bit tricky. You'll have to pass through a cave deep in the flower fields. Hope you can find it.

choice:9:0:1.text: I could take a look for you.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 不如我替你们过去看看？
choice:9:0:1.male: I could take a look for you.
choice:9:0:1.female: I could take a look for you.

choice:9:1:2.text: A ghost, you say? Now I have to see it for myself!
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 闹鬼？那我必须去看看了！
choice:9:1:2.male: A ghost, you say? Now I have to see it for myself!
choice:9:1:2.female: A ghost, you say? Now I have to see it for myself!
